name: deerflow-im-bridge
description: Standalone IM bridge that brings dsh-im-style multi-bot channel management to DeerFlow without touching DeerFlow source. Bridges Feishu and personal WeChat (iLink, ported from dsh-im) to DeerFlow Gateway via PAT-authenticated REST/SSE.

scripts.build:ui: cd admin-ui && npm install && npm run admin:build
